affected.product: افزونه پیامک ووکامرس | Persian WooCommerce SMS

descriptions.value: The افزونه پیامک ووکامرس | Persian WooCommerce SMS WordPress plugin before 7.3.2 does not sanitise and escape a parameter before reflecting it back into an HTML attribute, leading to Reflected Cross-Site Scripting that is executed in the browser session of a logged-in privileged user who is tricked into submitting a crafted cross-site request.

assertions.title: Persian WooCommerce SMS 7.2.0 - 7.3.1 - Reflected XSS via 'pwsms_mobiles' Parameter

descriptions.description: CWE-79 Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

title: Persian WooCommerce SMS 7.2.0 - 7.3.1 - Reflected XSS via 'pwsms_mobiles' Parameter
